notes.title: 🚀 Seeking pilots for fast-paced Team v. Team combat - 16OCT21
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38661360/cccdfd32c4e67b6d4b4c83cc392643664c7c9f2e.png[/img]

We've got an exciting playtest coming up this Saturday, October 16th at 4PM UTC (5PM UK, 11AM CST)  We're testing a lot of new functionality that we're very excited to showcase.

You can download Age of Ascent now from the store page! 

After you download, you'll be able to log-in right away and check out the in-game hangar, but you won't be able to launch into space until the playtest starts.  Feel free to hang out in the hangar until then to check out our improved visuals.  When the playtest kicks off we'll run for an hour, so you'll have plenty of opportunity to blow up some developers!

notes.title: 🚀 Join us for an epic PvP space battle
notes.content:
Age of Ascent is a truly massive multiplayer space game set in a vast galaxy, where you can play solo or join an alliance to explore and advance in an ever-evolving sandbox environment. It features six degrees of freedom direct-piloting real-time battles with thousands of ships; millions in the same galaxy, an entirely player-driven economy, deep strategy, and multi-device support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441580/

Download our demo and join us.  The devs will be in there too, so join us and see how many times you can shoot them down!

notes.title: 🔴 Live-stream Q&A with Devs + Space combat
notes.content:
Age of Ascent is a MMOFPS that features six degrees of freedom direct-piloting real-time battles with thousands of ships; millions in the same galaxy. As we continue to develop the game, we will be adding an entirely player-driven economy, deep strategy, and exploration in an evolving sandbox world.

Join us for a live-stream session to talk to the devs, and find out how we are using technology in a new way to create a virtually unlimited single shard universe, where you will be able to play across multiple devices and see that same world.  Check out our awesome new visual style and talk to the creative guy who designed it.  

AND – we will also be running a PVP combat playtest, during the live-stream session, so you can get in some great dog-fighting at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38661360/342a6382791bfcb08c27e6f19dd221c760bf986d.gif[/img]

Download our demo and join us  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441580/

notes.title: 🚀 Live PvP MMOFPS vs Devs
notes.content:
The year is 2176 and humanity has been forced to abandon the earth and rise into space, to start a new civilisation. Faster-than-light travel and communications have been achieved, and now it is time to help build the new world and fight for your way of life.

Age of Ascent is a truly massive multiplayer space game set in a vast galaxy. It features direct-piloting real-time battles with thousands of ships in a single universe, and as we continue to develop the game, we will be adding an entirely player-driven economy, deep strategy, and exploration in an evolving sandbox world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38661360/342a6382791bfcb08c27e6f19dd221c760bf986d.gif[/img]

For the Steam Autumn Festival, we are showcasing the PVP combat module only – with a new technology base and our awesome new visual style!  Everyone will be in the same ship loadout, and it’s everyone for themselves.  

Here’s some reviews of our PVP combat playtests:

[i]“Thousands of players from around the world in dogfights across a single, continuous battlezone without sharding or slowing down gameplay… a grand experiment”[/i]  PC Gamer

[i]“Age of Ascent is poised to become something special, one of those games that players will point to years down the road and say, 'Yep, that was the one that changed everything”[/i] MMORPG​.com

[i]“Brilliant… I’m just like ‘oh my god!’…. If you’re a spaceship fan you absolutely have to get in and muck around with this… you should totally get there” [/i] Scott Manley

Download our demo and join us.  The devs will be in there too, so join us and see how many times you can shoot them down!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441580/
